before_times: new to shooting, or experienced (new shooters get the package or a lesson, and the safety briefing)
how many shooters, and the age of each (sets the lane and who may come)
a rental firearm, or their own
for flow B: a home or private land, and the town
after_time: anything the instructor should know (left-handed, a past injury that affects grip)
secure_page_only: the waiver and the range rules, signed by each shooter (a parent signs for anyone under 18)
the date of birth of each shooter (age limits)
for a rental: a yes that the renter isn't barred by the federal or state rules from having a firearm (a switch)
for flow B at home: that every firearm will be unloaded with ammunition stored in another room, and where children are during the lesson
for flow B on private land: that the customer owns or may use the land, that shooting is allowed there, and the backstop
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult for themselves; a parent or legal guardian books for anyone under 18 and shoots on the same lane; nobody under 8 on the firing line (the range's rule)

stop.words: someone shot or hurt now, a firearm accident, a threat to hurt someone
stop.say: Call 911 now. Get to a safe place.

stop.words: words about ending one's life or hurting oneself
stop.booking: no booking in that chat; staff are told privately, with no words passed on

go_on.words: pregnant, or bringing a young child to an indoor range
go_on.what: the booking goes on; the range's own note about lead and noise is shown; Rosie gives no medical advice

go_on.words: a hearing or heart condition, a recent surgery on the hands, arms or shoulders
go_on.what: the booking goes on; it's noted privately for the instructor

safety_and_stop_words.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency → call 911, and no booking

steps.name: Waiver and range rules
steps.when: signed on the secure page while booking
steps.who: every shooter; a parent or guardian signs for anyone under 18
steps.result: signed: it books; not signed: no shooting until it's signed at the counter

steps.name: Safety briefing
steps.when: at the counter at the start of a shooter's first visit, 15 minutes
steps.result: done: the shooter goes to the lane; not able to follow the range rules: no shooting today

steps.name: Photo ID
steps.when: at the counter, every visit with a rental
steps.result: shows the right age: the rental goes ahead; none: no rental today

steps.name: Barred-person yes for a rental
steps.when: on the secure page while booking
steps.who: every renter, where the federal and state rules apply (a switch)
steps.result: a yes: it books; a no: no rental, told kindly, the reason never texted

steps.name: Home or land checklist (flow B)
steps.when: on the secure page while booking
steps.result: all yes: it books; a no: the instructor calls before anything is booked

first_steps_and_forms.prep: bring a photo ID; wear closed-toe shoes and a crew-neck top (hot brass); no alcohol before; arrive 15 minutes early for the briefing; bring your own firearm unloaded and cased

staff.skills: range safety officer, handgun instructor, rifle instructor, carry-permit instructor, youth instructor, in-home safety lessons
staff.licenses_or_certificates: each instructor's training certificate and ratings are the range's own word, shown to the owner; not checked by Rosie (D96)
staff.supervision: a range safety officer on duty for every open lane; at most 6 lanes per range safety officer (the range's rule)
staff.who_oks: the owner OKs fees, refunds and private-land lessons; the range safety officer may stop anyone from shooting
staff.stand_in: a lesson's instructor may be replaced only by one with the same skill, offered first, never assumed; a class's instructor by one with the same certification

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult for themselves; a parent or legal guardian books for anyone under 18 and shoots on the same lane; nobody under 8 on the firing line (the range's rule)
children_and_age.minors_texts: a minor's texts go to the parent or guardian

visit.check_in: at the counter: the check-in code, the photo ID for a rental, the waiver on file, and the safety briefing for a first visit; the class roster for classes; at the customer's home or land (flow B): the code at the door
visit.done: the check-in code, or the instructor's DONE; the rental firearms are checked back in before the shooter leaves
visit.changes_at_visit: more lane time only if the next booking allows, priced first; a cease-fire or lightning stops shooting; a lesson stopped for safety is done another way or moved
visit.before_work: the range safety officer assigns the lane and checks eye and ear protection; at a home, the instructor checks every firearm used is unloaded and the ammunition is in another room before the lesson

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: none checked by Rosie: a range needs no state license in most places; the business registration and the range's local permits are the owner's own word; where the state's rules require a training certificate for a class, the owner says so (a switch from the state form)
license.who: the range for its registration and permits; each instructor for their own training certificate
license.ask: optional: the registration number and any permit number the range wants shown; nothing is checked
license.insurance: liability insurance is the range's own matter; optional for the booking
license.background: any background or ownership check is the business's own step, outside Rosie; Rosie never checks it

never_in_a_text: whether someone owns firearms, which ones, serial numbers, permit numbers, the barred-person answer, health notes and any crisis words never go in a text: only the secure page
